claim: Draw parity does not mean 'is on screen' for XOR figures: clears, scrolls and text wipe or move them without an erase, so visibility needs more than a parity count.

evidence.text: Other writers on figure bits: ROM PO-CHAR 0x0BBC 15,777; tile writer 0xB378 1,204; ROM CLS 0x0E59 6; clear 0xB2A6 1; bottom-third scroll 0xDED2/0xDEEA. XOR overlay with figures in front chosen.
